Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly defined the calculation of atomic mass. In standard chemistry and physics contexts, the "mass of an atom" (or mass number) is calculated by summing the number of protons and neutrons. Electrons have a mass approximately 1/1836 that of a proton, which is negligible for integer-based multiple-choice questions. The correct sum is 6 (protons) + 7 (neutrons) = 13 (Option C). The Planner erroneously included the 6 electrons in the count, leading to the wrong answer of 19.
